Sandbox_OperationAcorn_HiddenZombieFix_t: Draws zombies that stand in plain view but are left undrawn, and lets them see you too. Needs PZ Tools. Does nothing while the Zombie Visibility Fix mod is on. Default: on.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_Monologue_tooltip: The character says a short line over their head at moments such as a cure, a test or reaching a mission's place. Default: on.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_CreditMultiplier_: Multiplies the credits every delivery earns.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_TrustThresholdMul: Multiplies the trust each stage and milestone needs. Lower means faster progress.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_BonusMultiplier_t: Multiplies the bonus credits for codex goals, first-time shredding of an item kind, fully searched buildings and kill milestones.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_RequestPrice_tool: Percent of the fixed unit price paid for this week's requested items. 100 is the standard (600 / 1,500 / 4,000 a unit); the request price upgrades multiply on top of it.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_HelicopterArrival: Multiplies the time from a call to the helicopter's arrival. At 1 it is 4 to 6 hours at the start, and it shortens as trust rises.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_CallIntervalMulti: Multiplies the time after a helicopter call before you can call again. At 1 it is 3 days at the start, and it shortens as trust rises.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_HelicopterNoiseMu: Multiplies how far away zombies hear the drop helicopter. At 1 it is 100 tiles; at 0 zombies do not hear it.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_BoxReissueCostMul: Multiplies the price of a new delivery box. At 1 it is 10,000 credits. A short balance becomes debt.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_MissionDeadlineMu: Multiplies the time you get to seal a mission's item into a delivery box. At 1 it is 7 days.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_MissionIntervalMu: Multiplies the time after a mission ends or expires until the next one comes. At 1 it is 3 days.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_ShopPriceMultipli: Multiplies shop prices, except upgrade serums and delivery box reissues.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_KitsForSale_toolt: Bag capacity, bag weight, trunk and engine kits reach the shop at the first milestone. Default: on.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_CureSerumPriceMul: Multiplies the price of a cure serum. At 1 it is 500,000 credits.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_CureSerumShelfLif: Multiplies the time from receipt until a cure serum no longer works. At 1 it is 7 days.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_UpgradeSerumPrice: Multiplies the price of upgrade serums. At 1 a tree's first serum is 8,000 credits.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_UpgradeSerumGrowt: Multiplies how much each serum of a tree costs over the one before. At 1 it is 15%% more; at 0 the price does not rise. From the 27th on, the price rises by a fixed amount.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_UpgradeEffectMult: Multiplies enhancement effects that have a number.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_SharedSerumMilest: After the top stage, a shared enhancement serum comes every this many trust milestones.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_ShredDecayMultipl: Sets how fast shredding the same kind again yields fewer sample bundles. At 1 a kind shredded 50 times lately yields half. Higher decays more slowly.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_MissionGuards_too: When you first come near a mission's building, it is filled with zombies up to a number set by the mission's level (about 10 at the first, about 30 at the fifth, scaled by the zombie population), dressed for the place, such as police at a police station. Some lie or sit and stay inside. Default: on.
